_about: nzfarmsource.co.nz — site overrides on top of fonterra-shared-block-mapping.json (same cmp-* component library as kituafund.com / nutiani.com). Sitemap exposes navigation fragments as pages (menu--*, footer-navigation) and 106 myaccount pages.

experience-fragment.rationale: Experience fragment wrapper (header/footer XFs on 913 pages, plus embedded content XFs) → EDS fragment; header/footer content is migrated to the EDS header/footer documents.

article-listing.rationale: Article listing with category tag links, hidden filter state and card grid (version_1) on 12 hub pages → query-index listing block with filters.

qualtrics-siteintercept-1vf0zvb.rationale: Qualtrics Site Intercept feedback widget ('Was this page helpful?' thumbs buttons) on 17 pages — third-party survey integration, load via delayed.js rather than as an authored block.

social-icons.rationale: Social icon links in the footer XF → EDS footer.

column-container.rationale: Panel of linked logo/image tiles inside a carousel panel container → Cards (logo grid variant).

search-results.rationale: Site search results (query box, result cards) → Block Collection Search on the query index.
